records.product: IHO Data Protection Scheme - S-63 (S-57 ENC) and S-100 security scheme, with OEM and Data Server agreements
records.territory: Worldwide, through IHO member hydrographic offices
records.licenceScope: The scheme defines the security constructs and operating procedures for Data Servers and Data Clients: piracy protection by encrypting ENC data, selective access limited to the cells a customer is licensed for, and authentication that data came from approved sources. OEM and Data Server applicants sign the applicable S-63/S-100 agreement via the IHO application process; the IHO issues final OEM credentials (M_ID/M_KEY) and recommends the generic S-64/S-164 credentials for OEMs still developing. The S-100 scheme is in testing.

records.notes: No fee schedule appears on the page and the agreement text is not public; currency is not stated and is recorded as EUR only as the contract base currency, flagged unverified. Obtaining S-63 decryption credentials is an organisational process - application, signed agreement, IHO-issued credentials - not a download, and the IHO issues final OEM credentials only when an OEM is ready to launch. Consequence: even public-domain national ENC cells cannot be decrypted or displayed lawfully without this scheme relationship; owning the cells does not authorise a display system. A legacy path of the same content is at https://iho.int/en/enc-data-protection-s-57 (retrieved).
